editor.selectHint: Pick a tag on the left to rename, recolor, move or delete it.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Full path <0>{{path}}</0>. Renaming it updates every sample and chip.

parent.label: Parent
parent.hint: Moving a tag carries its children with it.

delete.title: Delete this tag
delete.body_one: {{count}} sample loses the tag. Files on disk are untouched.
delete.body_other: {{count}} samples lose the tag. Files on disk are untouched.

cascade.title: Delete <0>{{name}}</0> and everything under it?
cascade.body: This is a parent tag. Deleting it also deletes its <0>{{children}} child tags</0>, and removes all of them from <0>{{samples}} samples</0>.
